scope: All 591361 original measured DEM nodes in the closed ±48km square; one real v58 Float32 mesh, no rays or adaptive points

plan.order: increasing iz then ix; both inclusive

errorStream.encoding: one Float64LE signed error per node, no header, row-major iz/ix; stream hashed but not retained

histogram.layout: index0 underflow; index1=[-5000,-4999), ... index10000=[4999,5000); index10001 overflow

maskDefinition: Saved bilinear coast distance at original DEM nodes: landMask iff coastKm>=0, seaMask otherwise; material-mask categories, not independent physical coastline/land-cover truth

worstCasePolicy.ties: ascending row-major order; exact extrema tie counts retained, tied full populations not saved

limits: Observed node errors are not a continuous maximum, areal integration, DEM accuracy certification, pixel displacement or causal shadow/art proof.
No edge/interior probe, mesh refinement, GPU, browser, render or performance qualification.
No per-node dense JSON or full mesh retained; error-stream digest cannot reconstruct omitted node values.
RSS/CPU/wall validity is decided from terminal wrapper record, not this result alone.
